summary: Added and verified local-only ecosystem replay for registry resolution, inert staging, activation preview and deterministic evidence output.
acceptance_evidence: Replay runs with network=false, external_llm=false, firecracker=false and host_package_manager=false.
Replay records registry, policy pack, workflow pack, lockfile, staging root and active set hashes.
Replay verifies staging remains inert: active=false and activation_prepared=false.
Replay emits release_gate.consumable=true and status=passed for release provenance consumption.
Running with -EnableUnsafeFixture fails closed before promotion.

commands.summary: Unsafe fixture mode fails at adversarial-fixtures before release promotion.
Functional replay remained green after ecosystem replay was added.

blocked_shortcuts: Replay does not depend on external LLM, network, Firecracker or host package manager.
Install/stage is not treated as activation.
Unsafe fixture failure is explicit and not silently skipped.
promotion_impact: Production release gates can now consume a deterministic local ecosystem replay result.
